data.name: ImportIntro
data.value: Each line of the CSV file creates an account in CyberArk with the rights of your session (“Add accounts” on the safe, and “Update account content” for the passwords). Required columns: address and user name, plus safe and platform unless the defaults below are filled in. Optional: name, logon domain, password, allowed machines, CPM management (yes/no), reason for manual management. Column names in English, French or Italian; a file made with Export can be imported.
